Introduction
============

PsrPopPySuper is a modernized Python3 port of Sam Bates' PsrPopPy code (https://github.com/samb8s/psrpoppy).
This project retains the original code's functionality while updating interfaces and adding newer
electron models (for example NE-2025) alongside NE-2001 and LMT85.

Contributions are welcome via the project's GitHub repository.
